title: Bump actions/checkout in a workflow file
intent: Raise the actions/checkout pin in .github/workflows to a target major version so CI stays on a maintained action release.

preconditions.description: shell tool available in the run sandbox

inputs.command: for f in .github/workflows/*.yml; do sed -i 's|actions/checkout@v[0-9]*|actions/checkout@v2|g' "$f"; done

failure_modes.symptom: marker file missing or incomplete after write
failure_modes.response: re-run the write step; do not promote on partial marks
